$comment: v2.5 — landing RIASEC stickers keep current sticker composition but switch to questionnaire-style characters and landing paper fill

global_rules.composition: keep the current landing sticker layout — axis-aligned rounded-square border, large letter on the left, one character on the right, small corner badge bottom-right
global_rules.background_fill: full canvas filled with landing paper color #FDFCF8 — no transparency required, no black interior fill, no dark-mode treatment
global_rules.character_style: match KursoKo questionnaire art style: unDraw-inspired student character, thin 2px dark outline #2D2D2D on the character only, flat fills, minimal dot eyes, natural hair colors
global_rules.outline_discipline: large letter may keep its current dark outline and white separation; character keeps thin dark outline; supporting props stay simpler than the character and should not gain thick sticker cutouts
global_rules.prop_density: minimal — one hero prop and at most one small support prop/icon
global_rules.facing: characters angle slightly inward-left toward the large letter for consistency
forbidden: white sticker cutout around the character
changing the border shape or overall sticker composition
